android.desc:
LEETA ID Photo is an ID photo and passport photo making app that uses advanced AI technology to intelligently cutout images.Using this app, you can take US passport photos, US Baby passport photos, US tourist visa photos, DV lottery photo, Green card photo, qualification exam, document applications and other ID photos anytime! No  registration, 30s to quickly generate the ID photos and passport photos you need. With just a mobile phone, you can create standard and compliant ID photos and passport photos at home!

■■  Why choose「LEETA ID Photo」?■■
【User friendly. Done in 30seconds】
Worried about complicated operations?「LEETA ID Photo」 provides a shooting guide, choose the required specs → shoot the photo → save the satisfied ID photo, in three steps you can make the ID photo you want! No professional photography skills are required, and there is no limit to the number of shots until you are satisfied!  No burden, anyone can use it!

【One click to change ID background】
Can't find a suitable ID photo or Passport photo shooting background? As long as 「LEETA ID Photo」 recognizes your face shape, it can auto crop photo and remove the photo background for you. You can choose the background color to suit your needs. Any photo with a complicated background can be turned into an ID photo or Passport photo anytime, anywhere!

【Layout auto-setting, easy to print】
Is it troublesome to print ID photos or Passport Photos?「LEETA ID Photo」frees your hands. All you need to do is select the appropriate size of photo paper, and AI will auto format it for you.You can print them at your nearby Walmart, CVS, Costco, etc. or on your home printer. Electronic data is stored for 180 days and can be downloaded to the album for use at any time.

【Get passport photos at home】
「LEETA ID Photo」app is famous for the high quality results. In addition to being of high quality, digital passport photos will also be correctly sized and formatted, ensuring that your application will be processed quickly and smoothly. Using「LEETA ID Photo」is the best way to ensure that your passport application is not delayed due to an incorrect or low-quality photograph.It is the perfect solution for busy travelers who need high-quality passport photographs without having to leave their home or office.
